720	At the top, the connection between the head and the body is
721	the throat. The throat is
722	the connector: it joins the intellectual part with the
723	animal part, the physical part that man shares
724	with the animal, whose whole purpose is simply, technically,
725	to allow a person to exist. That is, thought seemingly
726	could exist only in the head, without the body. But then
727	a person could not bring thought from
728	potential into action and carry it out. So the carrying out
729	of thought is found in the instruments of action, the instruments of action from the
730	shoulders
731	down. Thought happens in the head. What happens in the connection,
732	the speech? The throat, the throat and the mouth, that is
733	speech. Speech is this
734	connection. The three actions, or the three domains of
735	the possibility of
736	human action. And this is an idea that appears in Kabbalah many
737	times: the three fields of action are thought,
738	speech and deed. Deed is the action of the hands,
739	of the legs, action.
740	Speech is speech,
741	and thought. These are levels, one above
742	the other. Thought is where everything is found. That is to say,
743	thought is the most fantastic field and the most
744	exclusive, unique one of man. Man is able
745	to think, able to understand, able
746	to think. Deed is something shared by man and the animals.
747	Many of the deeds that we, as human beings,
748	do, we do on an instinctive level like
749	animals. We are also able to do deliberate
750	deeds, meaning that the end of the deed comes after thought
751	first. So there is thought and there is deed. What
752	does the throat connect?
753	Speech. Speech, then, is
754	an amazing tool, unique, exclusive to man. Only human beings
755	speak.
756	I mean intelligent speech. True, dolphins too
757	supposedly speak, and there is also the language of birds, but
758	that is chirping,
759	mere sounds, it is not intelligent speech. Intelligent speech
760	is exclusive, it is unique to man. And the uniqueness
761	comes from the fact that only man has
762	a soul, a soul in the higher
763	spiritual sense. And therefore the combination of body and soul is expressed
764	in speech. This is what makes speech so
765	immensely important, because, as we said, speech is the
766	garment of
767	thought. If we understand it correctly, then through these
768	things we can understand the commandment
769	in the Torah that one must keep
770	one's word: "That which has gone out of your lips you shall keep
771	and do." "He shall not profane his word." If a person says something and does not
772	fulfill it, this is called profaning the
773	word. Let us explain this expression for a moment. It appears, by the way,
774	in the book of Bamidbar, Parashat Matot, in the laws of vows: "If a man
775	vows a vow to HaShem... he shall not profane his word." What does
776	"profane" mean? A word that is not fulfilled is called
777	profaned. Let us explain the word "to profane." What
778	is
779	profanation? In the previous Parashah, Parashat Ki Tetzê,
780	we learned at the end of the Parashah: "If one is found
781	slain, fallen, it is not known who struck him." What is a "challal," a slain one?
782	Unfortunately we know this expression
783	too well from the wars of Israel, the slain.
784	The slain fall. What is a "challal"? Why is a person who died or
785	was killed called
786	a challal? This is also connected to the word
787	"chillul," profanation. Profanation is always a state that is the antithesis of
788	profanation: that is sanctification.
789	Desecration of the holy: Shabbat is
790	holy Shabbat. It is forbidden to desecrate the Shabbat, "those who profane it shall surely be put to death."
791	Desecration of Shabbat: why is it called chillul? The word chillul
792	is connected to the word
793	"chalal," empty space,
794	void. To make a "challal" is to take something that has content and remove
795	its content from it.
796	That is called
797	chillul. The people
798	of Israel: when HaShem chose us from among all
799	the nations at the Revelation at Mount Sinai, He sent Moshe Rabbeinu
800	and proposed to us: "You shall be for Me a kingdom of priests and a
801	holy nation." So I always say jokingly that every Jew
802	is in fact a goy, only he has to be a
803	holy goy. "You shall be holy, for I am holy, HaShem." The people of
804	Israel is a nation like all nations, but it is holy, it has in it
805	holiness. The antithesis of
806	holiness is secularism. By the way, this expression is a
807	shocking expression that we all got used to calling and using, but
808	it is an expression that, for one who understands its meaning, people
809	speak and do not understand what they are saying. What does it mean
810	to be a Jew
811	"secular"? "Secular" comes from the language of chillul, from the language of
812	uprooting holiness. I am a Jew, but I do not
813	do anything in holiness, I do not do mitzvot,
814	"who has sanctified us with His commandments." I do not want to be sanctified
815	by His commandments, and I live my life as if I were not
816	a Jew. Now, if a gentile lives his life as a non-Jew,
817	fine, he is a gentile. But a Jew has
818	the obligation of holiness. When he removes from within himself
819	the holiness, he creates
820	a void, the chillul. So a person
821	who was killed, murdered, or from whom his
822	soul departed, a void is created, because the central, highest,
823	spiritual thing that gives him life, "and He breathed into his nostrils the soul of
824	life," He gave breath into his nostrils a soul of life.
825	The soul gives life to the body, so when this
826	soul departs, a void is created. Therefore a person who fell in battle
827	or in general
828	was murdered, not only in battle, as it says in the Torah: "If one is found
829	slain, fallen in the field, it is not known..." It does not have
830	to be someone who fell in battle. A person from whom
831	his central point has departed, which is
832	the soul. "He shall not profane his word": there is also such a thing, speech
833	is holy. Whoever understands what we explained regarding
834	speech, that speech is the action of the holy soul
835	in the body: now, the moment the soul acts in the body
836	and intelligent words come out, when a person knows what
